============================================================================
OmniBuf-ES Benchmark Suite (Node.js v24.22.1 / darwin-arm64 / Apple M1 Pro)
Workload: Canonical PeerUpdate (nested submessage, 4 neighbors, arrays, scalars)
============================================================================

### 1. Full Message Encode Speed

| Codec / Operation | Latency (ns/op) | Throughput (ops/sec) | Wire Size (B) | vs Baseline |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| OmniBuf |    985 ns | 1,015,645 | 366 | 1.00x (baseline) |
| protobufjs |   1256 ns | 796,232 | 341 | 1.28x slower |
| @bufbuild/protobuf (protobuf-es) |   2117 ns | 472,378 | 341 | 2.15x slower |
| google-protobuf |   4578 ns | 218,430 | 341 | 4.65x slower |
| @msgpack/msgpack |   3297 ns | 303,277 | 622 | 3.35x slower |
| JSON |   1789 ns | 559,107 | 791 | 1.82x slower |
